attributes.description: Reads the live value, quality and timestamp of each tag path. Returns JSON {count, values: [{path, value, quality, good, timestamp}]}. At most 50 paths per call; extra paths are dropped and a notice says so.
attributes.title: tagRead

parameters.name: tagPaths
parameters.description: Array of full tag path strings, e.g. ["[default]Folder/Tag"]. A comma-separated string is also accepted.
